QQQ.title: Should You Buy the Invesco QQQ ETF During the Stock Market Sell-Off? History Offers a Clear Answer.
QQQ.description: The Invesco QQQ ETF, which tracks the Nasdaq-100 index heavily weighted toward technology stocks (60%), is down 8.8% from its all-time high amid economic uncertainty and geopolitical tensions. Historical analysis suggests that despite five bear markets since 1999, the ETF has delivered a 10.3% compound annual return and 20.3% annually over the last decade, indicating that staying invested during market downturns has historically been rewarded.
QQQ.author: Anthony Di Pizio
